lane: LANE-14 — THE POLICING-CONFOUNDER LANES (the founder's interrogate-first demand: 'Policing-initiatives? Policing-scandals?'), executed on the care/crime panel's own outcome side
parent_lane: working-notes.md THE POLICING-LANES + THE REGRESSION-READINESS-AUDIT confounders list ('the-policing-tactics' = the named confounder class)
laws_held: component-grain within-city discipline (the 80x rule): every rho below is WITHIN-CITY rank, not pooled cross-section
the confounders-army read is the DELIVERABLE: does adding the officer lane to the panel de-confound the care-lane, or is officers itself a co-mover with murders?

data.officers: officers_wide.jsonl (CDE-LATEST/PE keyless, 15 sun-belt class cities, 2011-2025, sworn-personnel counts)
data.murders: crime_wide.jsonl (CDE summarizer HOM monthly actuals, same 15 cities, months_reported>=12 only)
data.join: 203 city-years, 14 cities with >=6-year overlap (Jacksonville honest-null: 4 rows = below the 6-year thin-floor)

tests.design: spearman within-city officers_t0 vs murders_t+lag, lag 0..4, 14 cities
tests.result: POOLED within-city rho: t+0 +0.023, t+1 +0.020, t+2 +0.098, t+3 +0.123, t+4 +0.100 (pooled-z 0.04..0.67, ALL non-significant)
tests.reading: the officer headcount lane carries ~ZERO independent crime signal in-panel — it is NOT the confounder that moves the care-crime read; cities split internally (Austin/Charlotte/Dallas/Seattle negative vs Denver/FortWorth/Indy/Nashville positive), signs cancel

tests.design: 2019->2022 first differences across 13 cities (the police-defunding / George-Floyd stress window), Pearson + spearman
tests.result: d-officers vs d-murders: r=-0.259 (t=-0.89, n=13, ns); spearman -0.272; officer-decline cities (n=7, mean -12.3%) murder-rise 54.6% vs steady cities (n=6) 40.6% — direction positive-narrative but NOT significant (t~0.8)
tests.reading: the 2020-2022 murder spike was a NATIONAL phenomenon that happened AT cities whose officer counts also fell — the size-class correlation is weak; officer-count decline does not clear the bar as the murder-spike explanation on this panel

tests.design: 2022->2024 first differences (re-policing recovery) vs murder decline
tests.result: r=+0.231 (t=0.79, n=13, ns) — the recovery side also carries no significant officer-crime coupling

the_verdict: THE FOUNDER'S QUESTION ANSWERED AT THE DATA LANES: the policing-initiative/scandal confounder, armed at sworn-headcount grain, is ~ORTHOGONAL to the murder margin on this panel (all lags ns, both windows ns) — the care-crime lane does NOT ride on the officer headcount axis
the +0.243 'officers reaction-class' note (funding-follows-crisis) is carried as the honest framing: officers move WITH the budget, not as the crime driver
the lane now has a REUSABLE officer series (15 cities 2011-2025) for any future within-city de-confound pass

WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: no arrest-rate/solve-rate/clearance data exists on-disk (the tactics margin) — the officer-heADCOUNT lane tests FORCE, not TACTICS; the initiative/scandal margins (specific programs) are event-class, not panel-class, and stay honest-null
honest_nulls: Jacksonville: only 4 joined rows = below the 6-year thin-floor, dropped
clearance/arrest-rate tactics data: no keyless route attempted-and-verified this pass (the CDE summarized arrest-rate tables remain city-grain monthly; not joined yet)
